scenario_description: A saved nine-day escalation in the Red Sea and Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, December 14–22 2023, from Houthi warnings to a near-total shipping halt.

signals.title: Houthi rebels warn of further strikes on shipping amid rising Red Sea tension
signals.body: Houthi rebels warn of further strikes on commercial shipping amid rising tension in the Red Sea.

signals.title: Missile strikes cargo ship near Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, crew unharmed
signals.body: A missile strikes a cargo ship near the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait; the crew is reported unharmed.

signals.title: US Navy deploys warships for naval buildup in Red Sea shipping lanes
signals.body: The US Navy deploys additional warships as part of a naval buildup in Red Sea shipping lanes near the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait.

signals.title: Second tanker attacked in Red Sea as Houthi strikes continue near Bab-el-Mandeb
signals.body: A second tanker was attacked in the Red Sea near the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait as Houthi strikes continue.

signals.title: Suez Canal Authority reports port disruption as vessel traffic falls
signals.body: The Suez Canal Authority reports port disruption as vessel traffic through the canal falls sharply.

signals.title: US Treasury imposes sanctions on Houthi financial network
signals.body: The US Treasury imposes fresh sanctions on a financial network tied to the Houthi movement.

signals.title: Container ship struck by missile in Bab-el-Mandeb Strait, Maersk suspends transits
signals.body: A container ship was struck by a missile in the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait; Maersk suspends transits through the area.

signals.title: US announces multinational naval deployment to protect Red Sea shipping
signals.body: The US announces a multinational naval deployment intended to protect commercial shipping in the Red Sea and Bab-el-Mandeb Strait.

signals.title: Houthi rebels declare blockade of Bab-el-Mandeb Strait to Israel-linked vessels
signals.body: Houthi rebels declare a blockade of the Bab-el-Mandeb Strait against vessels they say are linked to Israel.

signals.title: Major lines halt Red Sea transits as blockade risk grows, reroute via Cape of Good Hope
signals.body: Major shipping lines halt Red Sea and Bab-el-Mandeb Strait transits entirely as blockade risk grows, rerouting via the Cape of Good Hope.
